config.description: R3 single-variable control on the GQA ratio. TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat is LlamaForCausalLM with head_dim 64 and GQA 8:1; SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct is LlamaForCausalLM with head_dim 64 and full MHA. Same architecture, same head_dim, same order of size -- the only structural difference is the GQA ratio. Session 3's contrast (Qwen3-4B vs SmolLM2) moved head_dim, GQA ratio AND model family together and cannot attribute the gradient to any of them.
config.note_arch: LlamaForCausalLM is one of the architectures tpu-inference 0.25.0 actually implements in JAX (llama3.py). Qwen1.5-4B-Chat was the first choice and is UNSERVABLE: tpu_inference/models/jax/qwen2.py reads hf_config.text_config.hidden_size, which exists only on multimodal Qwen2 configs, so every text-only Qwen2ForCausalLM model raises AttributeError at engine start.
config.note_fractions: Top fraction is 0.99, not 1.0. max_position_embeddings is 2048, so bucket 2048 at full occupancy would need 2048 prompt tokens plus an output token and be rejected. 0.99 x 2048 = 2027 still maps to bucket 2048, and flatness is computed from ACTUAL lengths.
config.note_reading: The Qwen3-4B / SmolLM2 gap is present at EVERY bucket, not only at 4096: 1.00 vs 0.84 at 512, 0.96 vs 0.78 at 1024, 0.91 vs 0.73 at 2048. So capping at 2048 still tests the contrast. Against SmolLM2 at matched buckets: landing near SmolLM2's 0.73 at bucket 2048 means the GQA ratio does NOT drive the gradient and head_dim does; landing near Qwen3's 0.91 means GQA does.
config.note_size: 1.1B against SmolLM2's 1.7B. Flatness is a ratio of differences within one bucket, so absolute scale cancels; parameter count is not held constant and is stated as a residual difference rather than claimed away.
config.note_tp: 32 heads / 4 = 8, 4 kv / 4 = 1, intermediate 5632 / 4 = 1408 -- TP=4 shards cleanly.
config.note_weights: Chosen after THREE models failed to load, each for a different reason invisible in config.json's architecture field: Qwen1.5 (Qwen2ForCausalLM is registered but broken), Sheared-LLaMA-1.3B (no safetensors), and NousResearch/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf, which has the ideal geometry -- Llama arch, head_dim 128, MHA -- and whose weights carry 24 rotary_emb.inv_freq buffers that tpu-inference's loader rejects as invalid param paths. Llama-2-era exports persist those buffers; TinyLlama, SmolLM2 and Qwen3 have zero.
